definitions.explanation: Having parts that are closely packed together.
Not known or meant to be known publicly.
Having a close or private connection.

examples.japanese: {密|みつ}な{関係|かんけい}を{築|きず}く。
{三密|さんみつ}を{避|さ}けてください。
examples.english: Please avoid the 'three Cs' (closed spaces, crowded places, close contact).

examples.japanese: {密|みつ}に{連絡|れんらく}を{取|と}り{合|あ}う。

notes:
MEANINGS:
1. Dense/Close: {密|みつ}な{森|もり} (dense forest)
2. Secret: {秘密|ひみつ} (secret)
3. Close (relationship): {親密|しんみつ} (intimate)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{秘密|ひみつ} (secret)
・{親密|しんみつ} (intimate, close)
・{緻密|ちみつ} (precise, meticulous)
・{密度|みつど} (density)
・{密接|みっせつ} (close, intimate)
・{密輸|みつゆ} (smuggling)

COVID TERM:
{三密|さんみつ} (sanmitsu - the "three Cs") became widely used during the COVID-19 pandemic to describe situations to avoid:
・{密閉|みっぺい} (enclosed spaces)
・{密集|みっしゅう} (crowded places)
・{密接|みっせつ} (close contact)
